Capture date: 2026-11-14 UTC. Two fresh 30-day scratch org captures used synthetic company values and custom Account CompanyName rules. The orgs were deleted after capture. Rows cover Apex API 62.0 and 67.0, anonymous and @IsTest routes, with two repeats. Panel observations encode candidate and stored indexes in base 36 and omit confidence when it is 100. A question mark in one anonymous observation represents an unrelated unknown seed record; use the @IsTest observation for that panel. The range panels cover separate candidate ranges against the same stored values. The DML rows contain directed stored-to-candidate pairs and operation results.

Rows D1_nd and D1_nd2 (same words with different numbers), D1_jn (one-sided hyphen and underscore joins with a near word, and doubled letters), D1_qf (slash, parenthesis, dash and spaced-slash cross-forms) and D1_dp (Partner designator) cover Apex API 62.0 and 67.0, anonymous and @IsTest, two repeats; every observation agrees across API, route and repeat. Observation encoding as above. Names are synthetic.
